integrity: All theorem numbers, torus chain entries, integer minors, quotient ranks and graph automorphism orbits are regenerated from included standard-library Python; finite-field ranks are used only as rank bounds, not to infer integral primitivity.
scientific_limitations: One specific twelve-vertex Franklin graph only; two unordered particles, integral degree-two homology, embedded cycle-product tori.
No general family theorem, integral symmetry decomposition, or independent scientific audit.
The accessible abstract, not the complete text, of Barnett (2010) was examined; equivalent specialized prior computations remain possible.
title: Integral mixed-length torus generators for the Franklin graph configuration space
